free_tier.stated: Dead. t.me/TorrentXbot returns 'Telegram: Contact @Torrent' with no Start action: the username now resolves to a user account.

per_object_cap.stated: Not applicable: the bot is gone.

interface_detail: Was a Telegram chat bot that downloaded a torrent and uploaded it to Google Drive.
chaining: Nothing. The surviving path for the same job is a self-run mirror bot.
limits_note: No live limit exists to name.
binding_note: Nothing binds because nothing is served.
reliability_note: Second confirmation of the same failure: the Chinese directory already listed it under 'the following are all unusable' in 2022, and the handle is a user account today.
confidence_note: Read today: the page is a Contact action, not a Launch action. The 2022 directory corroborates the direction of travel.

evidence.proved: page title 'Telegram: Contact @Torrent', no Start Bot action, empty description
post 73: '@TorrentXbot downloads and uploads to Google Drive', listed later under 'the following are all unusable'
the handle offers only Send Message to a user account, with no Start Bot action
evidence.quote: If you have **Telegram**, you can contact [@TorrentXbot](tg://resolve?domain=TorrentXbot) right away.

notes: Do not re-open unless @Torrent is seen running as a bot. The 2022 directory is the useful artefact here: it recorded class-wide death four years before on 2026-10-23 confirmed two of the handles.
